_spec_ref: Operator decisions of 2026-08-21, refining Teil D. Separates three properties that PROJECT_META and the earlier implementation conflated.
core_principle: reproducibility != redistribution. A licensed dataset can be used reproducibly if the repository carries complete provenance and a content hash, so that a second party holding the same legitimate source can verify byte equality. Open redistribution remains a valuable property, but it must not be equated with data existence or with scientific reproducibility.

availability_status.meaning: Whether the series can be obtained at all, and on what terms.

redistribution_status.meaning: Whether the raw bytes may be republished from this repository.

reproducibility_status.meaning: Whether a second party can reconstruct the identical input. LICENSED_REPRODUCIBLE requires complete provenance plus a SHA-256 that a holder of the same licensed source can check byte-for-byte.

licensed_data_pathway.verification_contract: A second user with the same legitimate source recomputes the local file hash and compares it against the recorded expected_sha256. Equality establishes that both parties calibrated from identical bytes.
licensed_data_pathway.what_this_is_not: This is not open-data reproducibility. It is licensed reproducibility, and must be labelled as such in every report.

phase4_core_decision_rule._note: Evaluated in order. CORE is the only series whose outcome can force a STOP.

rules.condition: exact CORE openly acquired and validated
exact CORE legitimately acquired under licence, stored outside the repo, hashed, provenance complete
exact CORE exists commercially but the project holds no licence and no file
rules.meaning: A hard blocker for calibrated phases, but NOT a finding that the series does not exist.

rules.condition: an operator-approved proxy exists and is used
rules.caveat: The EMPIRICAL_SUPPORT ceiling must be reconsidered: a proxy-calibrated result is not evidence about the instrument actually held.

verdict_taxonomy.FAIL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE: SOURCE_NOT_FOUND, DATA_INVALID or INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY. An epistemic finding: the series does not exist in usable form.
verdict_taxonomy.FAIL_ACCESS_CONSTRAINT: LICENCE_REQUIRED and the licence or file has not been obtained. NOT an epistemic finding: the data exists and is commercially available; the project has not acquired it. STOP for calibrated phases all the same.
verdict_taxonomy.BLOCKED_NETWORK: Environment-level. No egress. Not a research finding of any kind.
verdict_taxonomy.rule: A generic FAIL is no longer an admissible Phase 4 verdict. The reason must be one of the specific values above.

GOLD.proxy_series: World Bank Pink Sheet, Gold (UK) 99.5% fine, London afternoon fixing, average of daily rates
GOLD.licence: CC BY 4.0, redistribution permitted with attribution
GOLD.difference: monthly MEAN of daily fixings versus MONTH-END value

mandatory_sensitivity.reason: Phase 6 rests on second moments (G2). Monthly averaging is a low-pass filter and will SUPPRESS measured variance relative to month-end sampling. A gold downside claim calibrated on averaged data would understate exactly the quantity the claim is about.
mandatory_sensitivity.requirement: The variance reduction induced by averaging must be quantified as its own proxy sensitivity before any Phase 6 result calibrated on this series is reported.
mandatory_sensitivity.must_not: This series must never be labelled as LBMA-identical.

CORE.reason: No acceptable open proxy. Vanguard NAV starts 2019-07-23 (INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY and a fund series, not the benchmark). Kenneth French is not FTSE All-World, is USD, lacks a net-of-withholding concept, and inherits MSCI/Bloomberg licence constraints. CORE remains the binding constraint.
